messages:
aparna: heads up — PR #4123 broke the Java SDK example in optimize/quant-profiles.md, it's failing docs CI. anyone available to triage?

jess: on it, checking the CI logs now.

matt: saw the failure earlier, error is a NoClassDefFoundError for QuantProfile during snippet build.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (failed) — https://ci.redwood/example/4123 — test-snippets failed (java-snippets).

aparna: if it's an import path change we should add a migration note and a tiny example showing the new import. try to avoid breaking other snippets.

samir: quick grep shows examples still use `com.redwood.optimize.QuantProfile` but runtime moved it to `com.redwood.optimize.profiles.QuantProfileV2`.

jess: minimal patch: replace import and constructor usage. sample change:```java
import com.redwood.optimize.profiles.QuantProfileV2;
QuantProfileV2 qp = QuantProfileV2.fromPreset("int8_eco");
```

matt: also noticed the batching guide uses `batch_size` in the config snippet; runtime accepts `max_batch_tokens` now. we should update both YAML and SDK snippets.

aparna: good catch. add both changes to the PR or do a follow-up? prefer a single small PR that fixes all snippet breakages. keep changes scoped to examples and an explicit migration header.

jess: I'll open 4124 with the Java + YAML fixes and a migration note under "Optimize toolkit -> Quantization profiles". will also add a short Python snippet showing equivalent:```py
from redwood.optimize import QuantProfile
qp = QuantProfile.from_preset("int8_eco")
```

samir: I'll run the local snippet harness: `tools/snippet-runner --lang java,py docs/optimize` and push any test-only tweaks.

matt: small config diff for the batching example:```yaml
# old
# batching:
#   batch_size: 8
# new
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  timeout_ms: 8
```

aparna: also check internal links — there were a couple of stale links to the old profiles page. update the redirects and add a one-line note in the changelog.

jess: PR 4124 opened: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/4124 — includes Java import fix, YAML batching rename, Python snippet, migration note, and link updates. CI triggered.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (pending) — run by jess on branch fix/snippet-compat.

samir: ran snippet harness locally, found a whitespace-sensitive code block in the caching example; pushed a tiny MD formatting fix.

matt: if CI is green, can we also add an automated test that lints for `com.redwood.optimize.QuantProfile` usage? prevents regressions.

jess: yes, adding a grep-based CI check in docs pipeline — low friction.

aparna: awesome. assign follow-ups: jess -> merge + CI check, samir -> run harness on merge, matt -> add lint rule in infra, aparna -> update changelog and send a short note in release highlights. :thumbsup:

jess: thanks — will monitor CI and post back.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (success) — all snippet tests passed.

jess: merged PR 4124. changelog entry added.

aparna: great, thanks everyone. leaving a one-line note in the Optimize toolkit docs about the rename and recommended migration steps.

matt: 👍 will follow up with the lint rule tomorrow.
